name: 空间连接
description: 按空间关系连接目标图层属性。
code_template:
import os
import geopandas as gpd

gdf = gpd.read_file('{input_file}')
join_gdf = gpd.read_file('{join_layer}')
if gdf.crs != join_gdf.crs:
    join_gdf = join_gdf.to_crs(gdf.crs)
result = gpd.sjoin(gdf, join_gdf, how='{how}', predicate='{predicate}')
output_file = '{output_file}'
os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(output_file) or '.', exist_ok=True)
result.to_file(output_file)
show_layer(output_file, '{layer_name}')
print(f'?????: {output_file}')
